# Every host the Workspace's own installers download from: the Agent's (install_*.go,
# node_install.go, jdk*.go, internal/jdkvendor) and the entrypoint's boot-time installs and
# agent CLI updates (workspace/entrypoint.sh), redirect hops and hosts named by a fetched
# install script or manifest included. On an enforcing egress gateway a host missing from
# the Control Plane's default allowlist breaks a Settings > Toolchains button or a boot
# install, with nothing pointing at the cause.
#
# Two tests read this file, one per Go module:
#   workspace/agent  installer_egress_hosts_test.go: every https:// host in those sources
#                    is listed here; a listed host found in none of them must say
#                    "redirect" in its comment.
#   control-plane    egress_installer_hosts_test.go: defaultEgressAllowlist admits every
#                    plain line and does NOT admit any "!" line.
#
# A "!" line is a host the product needs but deliberately leaves to the admin: a
# general-purpose storage endpoint anyone can upload to, which a builtin entry would stop
# the admin from blocking. The operator guide's egress section names these.
# A "~" line is a host the sources name but never fetch (a JSON "$schema" URL); neither
# test asks anything of it.
#
# Format: one host per line, optional "!" or "~" prefix, optional "# comment".

# JDK
api.adoptium.net
github.com                          # Adoptium binary link -> GitHub release; rtk releases
release-assets.githubusercontent.com # redirect: GitHub release -> asset storage
corretto.aws

# Node.js, Go, gcloud
nodejs.org
go.dev
dl.google.com                       # gcloud archive; also the redirect target of go.dev/dl
raw.githubusercontent.com           # nvm install script; Noto CJK font

# databases
cdn.mysql.com
repo1.maven.org                     # embedded Postgres (zonky)
deb.debian.org                      # Postgres client packages

# agent CLIs
claude.ai                           # Claude CLI install script
prod.download.cli.kiro.dev
lookaside.facebook.com              # muse CLI artifacts
awscli.amazonaws.com
s3.amazonaws.com                    # session-manager-plugin
cursor.com                          # Cursor install script (agent CLI update)
downloads.cursor.com                # Cursor CLI tarball (boot install, and the install script's)
antigravity.google                  # Antigravity install script (agent CLI update)
antigravity-cli-auto-updater-974169037036.us-central1.run.app # Antigravity version manifest
!storage.googleapis.com             # Antigravity CLI tarball (boot install and updates, both arches); x64 Chrome for Testing, which cdn.playwright.dev redirects to as well
~opencode.ai                        # "$schema" URL in the OpenCode config the entrypoint writes

# Chromium
cdn.playwright.dev
playwright.download.prss.microsoft.com
